NONE: › used in writing to represent the sound that people sometimes make in order to agree with or show understanding of something that has just been said
呃呵，嗯，喔，哦（表示肯定、贊成或理解的象聲詞）
› used in writing to represent the sound that people make when they discover that they have made a mistake or done something wrong
呃噢，哎呀（表示意識到犯了錯誤或過失的象聲詞）

example: Uh-oh, I think I just locked my keys in the car.
哎呀，我想我剛把鎖匙鎖在車裡了。

NONE: › used in writing to represent the sound that people sometimes make to give a negative answer
嗯，哼（表示否定回答象聲詞）

example: "You didn't have time to get food?" "Uh-uh, no chance."
「你沒有時間去買吃的嗎?」「嗯，完全沒有。」
